title: Progress
subtitle: Daily site records, verified physical progress and performance.

setup.title: Set up progress tracking

workPackages.label: Create work packages
workPackages.description: Break the scope into control units, each with an owner and a progress weight.

allocate.label: Allocate BOQ items
allocate.description: Link each work package to the BOQ items it covers, so progress can roll up.

baseline.label: Set the planned baseline
baseline.description: Optional — gives the progress curve a real planned line instead of an estimate.

setup.loadFailed: Progress setup could not be loaded. Reload this page to try again.

report.title: Daily progress report
report.emptyHint: Record the first daily report to start capturing site progress.

returnReason.label: Reason for return
returnReason.required: Enter a reason for the return

report.draftOnlyHint: Measurements can only be added while the report is a draft.
report.approvedHint: This report is approved and its measurements are now verified progress.
report.approveConfirmBody: Its measurements become verified progress and the report becomes read-only.
report.returnConfirmBody: The report goes back to the author to correct.
report.selfApprovalWarning: You prepared this report. Approving your own report may need a second reviewer.

measurement.title: Measurements
measurement.leafOnlyHint: Measure against a BOQ item (leaf), not a section.
measurement.empty: No measurements recorded on this report.
measurement.quantityRequired: Enter a quantity greater than zero

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.hint: Photos or short videos of the day's work. A photo shows work happened, not the exact quantity.
evidence.notReady: The file is still uploading. Try again once it finishes.
evidence.dropHint: Drag photos or videos here, or
evidence.wrongType: Only photos and videos can be attached.

verified.title: Verified progress
verified.subtitle: Physical progress per BOQ item, from approved daily reports only.
verified.empty: No verified progress yet. Approve a daily report to see progress here.

curve.title: Progress curve
curve.ariaSummary: Progress curve over {points, plural, one {# period} other {# periods}}. Latest planned {planned}, latest actual physical {physical}.
curve.insufficient: The progress curve begins once progress is recorded.
curve.provisionalNote: The planned line is an estimate until a baseline is set in Plan & Setup.

capture.alreadyRecorded: A snapshot is already recorded for this date.
capture.failed: Could not record the snapshot. Try again.

comparison.title: Period comparison
comparison.insufficient: Comparison appears once two periods have been recorded.

workPackage.title: Work packages
workPackage.subtitle: Control units that carry a responsible owner and a progress weight.
workPackage.emptyHint: Create work packages and allocate BOQ items to roll progress up to a project figure.

form.name: Name
form.weightHint: Fraction of the project (0–1). All work-package weights should total 100%.

allocate.title: Allocate BOQ item
allocate.leafOnly: Only BOQ items (leaves) can be allocated.
allocate.noBaseline: Baseline the BOQ before allocating items.

rollup.title: Project physical progress
rollup.weightsIncomplete: Work-package weights total {total} — the project figure is understated until they reach 100%.
rollup.unavailable: Add work packages with weights to see a project figure.

baseline.title: Planned baseline
baseline.subtitle: The planned progress curve the S-curve compares actuals against. Without one, the planned line is only an estimate.
baseline.workingCurveNote: This is the working curve — edit it freely. It stages the next baseline but does not change variance until you approve or re-baseline below.

governing.none: No baseline is governing yet. The S-curve compares against an estimate until you approve one.
governing.pointCount: {count, plural, one {# frozen point} other {# frozen points}}
governing.unpublishedHint: The working curve differs from the governing baseline. These staged changes do not affect variance until you re-baseline.
governing.approveNeedsCurve: Enter a working curve before approving a baseline.
governing.rebaselineSubtitle: Snapshot the current working curve as a new governing baseline. This supersedes the previous version and must cite a Variation.
governing.variationHint: A re-baseline must be justified by an approved change to scope or time.
governing.noteHint: Recorded on the new baseline version for the audit trail.
governing.noContract: This project has no main contract yet, so there are no variations to cite. A re-baseline needs a variation.
governing.noVariations: This contract has no variations to cite. Raise a variation before re-baselining.

baseline.noDates: Set the project start and end dates to generate a linear baseline.
baseline.empty: Add points, or start from a generator above.
baseline.errorRange: Each cumulative % must be between 0 and 100.
baseline.errorOrder: Cumulative % cannot go backwards over time.

signal.title: Cost vs physical progress
signal.costAheadHint: Spending is running ahead of physical progress — investigate the variance.
signal.progressAheadHint: Physical progress is ahead of recorded cost.
signal.alignedHint: Physical progress and cost are broadly aligned.
signal.insufficientHint: There is no forecast cost yet, so no comparison can be made.

collectionSignal.title: Collection vs physical progress
collectionSignal.alignedHint: Collection and physical progress are broadly aligned.
collectionSignal.cashAheadHint: Collection is running ahead of physical progress — the client is financing the work; watch advance exposure.
collectionSignal.workAheadHint: Physical progress is ahead of collection — ACCO is financing the client; chase certification and billing.
collectionSignal.insufficientHint: There is no contract value yet, so no comparison can be made.

programme.title: Milestones
programme.subtitle: Programme delivery milestones — construction stages with baseline dates. Verify a stage when it is complete; a verified milestone is the billing evidence for a payment-schedule installment.

states.emptyHint: Add the project's programme delivery stages with their baseline dates.

variance.early: {n, plural, one {# day early} other {# days early}}
variance.late: {n, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}

verify.title: Verify {name}
verify.hint: Confirm the stage is complete and record the date it actually finished. This becomes billing evidence for any linked payment installment.
verify.hintReleaseOne: Verifying this releases the {percent} {name} payment ({amount}) for invoicing.
verify.hintReleaseMany: Verifying this releases {count} payment installments for invoicing: {list}.

wpSchedule.title: Work package schedule
wpSchedule.subtitle: Each work package is a schedule phase — its planned window with the derived actual dates overlaid, plus verified progress and schedule health.
wpSchedule.noBaseline: A schedule is built from BOQ scope. Baseline the BOQ before setting up the schedule.
wpSchedule.emptyNoPackages: Create work packages and set their planned dates in Plan & Setup to build the schedule.
wpSchedule.emptyNoDates: No work package has planned dates yet. Set planned start and end dates in Plan & Setup to build the schedule.
wpSchedule.partial: {count, plural, one {# phase has no planned dates yet} other {# phases have no planned dates yet}} — they are listed without a bar.

scheduleWizard.title: Set up schedule
scheduleWizard.subtitle: Build the master schedule in four steps: start, assign scope, set dates, then weights.
scheduleWizard.noBaseline: The BOQ baseline was cleared. Baseline the BOQ before setting up the schedule.

gate.noBaseline: A schedule is built from BOQ scope. Baseline the BOQ before setting up the schedule.

cta.title: No schedule yet
cta.description: Set up the master schedule to see phases progress automatically from daily reports — no one types a % complete.
cta.setDescription: Phases, scope, dates and weights are set. Open the Schedule view for the live timeline.

start.lead: Start from ACCO's standard building schedule, or start blank and add phases yourself.
start.templateHint: Pre-creates the nine standard phases so you edit rather than invent.
start.blankHint: Add and name each phase yourself in the steps that follow.
start.alreadyHasPackages: This project already has work packages, so the template cannot be applied. Continue to edit the existing phases.

scope.lead: Assign BOQ items to each phase. A phase with no measurable scope (Design, Mobilization) can be marked schedule-only and tracked by dates alone.
scope.noPackages: No phases yet. Go back and apply the template, or add work packages in the table below.
scope.scheduleOnlyHint: Tracked by dates only — no BOQ scope, no % complete.
scope.unassigned: {count, plural, one {# BOQ item is not assigned to any phase} other {# BOQ items are not assigned to any phase}} — it counts towards nothing until assigned.
scope.allAssigned: Every BOQ item is assigned to a phase.
scope.scheduleOnlyFailed: Could not change the phase. A schedule-only phase must have no assigned items.

dates.lead: Set each phase's planned window. Auto-suggest sequences the phases back-to-back from the project start; adjust any row.
dates.noProjectStart: Set the project start date to auto-suggest the schedule. You can still set each phase's dates by hand.
dates.orderError: End date must be on or after the start date.
dates.nextWithUndated: {count, plural, one {Continue (# phase still undated)} other {Continue (# phases still undated)}}

weights.lead: Give each phase a weight so the project figure reflects how much each phase is worth. Distribute by BOQ value so you don't have to guess.
weights.missingScope: {count, plural, one {# measurable phase has no BOQ scope} other {# measurable phases have no BOQ scope}} — go back to Assign scope.
weights.missingDates: {count, plural, one {# phase has no planned dates} other {# phases have no planned dates}} — they will not appear on the timeline.

activity.title: Activities
activity.subtitle: The work breakdown under each package — planned dates and milestones. Dependencies are deliberately out of scope.
activity.noWorkPackages: Create work packages in Plan & Setup first, then break each into activities.
activity.dateOrder: End date must be on or after the start date.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.clearHint: No reports are waiting, and the progress model is complete.
attention.pendingVerification: {count, plural, one {# progress report awaiting verification} other {# progress reports awaiting verification}}
attention.pendingVerificationHint: Quantities do not count towards progress until a report is approved.
attention.weightsIncompleteHint: The project figure is understated until they reach 100%.
attention.unallocated: {count, plural, one {# billable BOQ item is not allocated} other {# billable BOQ items are not allocated}}
attention.unallocatedHint: An unallocated item contributes nothing to any work package.

packages.title: Work package progress
packages.noVsPlan: Planned progress is tracked for the project as a whole, not per work package.

masterSchedule.downloadFailed: Could not generate the master schedule PDF. Please try again.
